facts: alert accept (and dismiss) are refused on an Apple TV as unsupported, before any answer is sent.
A tvOS alert opens with focus on its cancel button and is answered with the remote: move focus with the D-pad, press select; Back (Menu) answers with the cancel button.
note: 298 alone, checked against the code (mobiumdriver/alerts.go AnswerAlert, errTVAlert), which still holds after #195. The stored answer (accept presses the cancel button) is wrong; 298 says focus starts on cancel, which it misread. Found: a TV alert of three buttons is refused naming app_alert button, which taps, and a TV refuses every touch.

findings.what: On an Apple TV an alert of three or more buttons is refused with the remedy 'app_alert with button set to one of them'; `button` presses by tapping the node, and a TV refuses every touch (errTVNoTouch), so the remedy cannot work there. A two-button TV alert with --button is refused as 'no touch screen' rather than pointing at the D-pad answer for alerts. Read from the code, not run on the Apple TV simulator.
findings.evidence: alert.go:177 WithRemedy("app_alert with button set to one of them…"); alert.go:248 s.driver.Tap; mobiumdriver/wda.go:101 noTouch = errTVNoTouch
